description: This file defines a template class 'LinkType' for managing JSON-RPC communication over WebSocket connections, including nested classes for communication channels, message handling, and RPC invocation. It also includes a 'SmartLinkType' class for higher-level management and event subscription, with support for asynchronous and synchronous RPC calls, event subscriptions, and plugin state monitoring within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: LinkType
classes.description: Template class managing JSON-RPC communication over WebSocket, including message handling, event subscription, and plugin state monitoring within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: SmartLinkType
classes.description: Template class providing higher-level management and event subscription capabilities, including plugin state handling and asynchronous RPC invocation.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::CommunicationChannel
classes.description: Inner class managing communication channels, message creation, and response handling.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::CommunicationChannel::FactoryImpl
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for resource allocation and watchdog management for JSONRPC messages.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::CommunicationChannel::ChannelImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the communication channel using WebSocket client type, handling message reception, sending, and state changes.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::Entry
classes.description: Represents an RPC call entry, supporting synchronous and asynchronous responses, timeouts, and aborts.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::Handler
classes.description: Manages registration, unregistration, and invocation of RPC methods.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::Statechange
classes.description: JSON container for plugin state change events.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::CurrentState
classes.description: JSON container for current plugin state.

classes.name: LinkType<INTERFACE>::Connection
classes.description: Manages plugin connection, event subscriptions, plugin state, and message dispatching.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Performs synchronous or asynchronous RPC calls with various parameter and response types.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Performs asynchronous RPC calls with callback handlers.
